name: Cascabel Bay
desc: Cascabel Bay is a Location in _Deepwoken_. It is a small sea making up the body of water surrounding [Fort Merit](location:fort_merit) and part of [Meteor Isle](location:meteor_isle).
additional_info:
-   The name "Cascabel Bay" refers to Fort Merit's original name: Fortress Cascabel.
-   Although released along with many other seas, Cascabel Bay is the only one to be controlled by a faction.
